categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests and adds unit tests across four test suites in src/test/ covering script.cpp functions.
categories.rationale: Adds unit test coverage for synthetic mutant edge cases in script.cpp boundary checks without demonstrating a realistic regression. The PR targets 12 surviving mutants across script classification and parsing functions (CScript::IsPayToTaproot, GetSigOpCount, HasValidOps, GetOp), but adding tests for their own sake ranks low within the category, particularly as reviewer feedback notes several claimed mutants are not actually killed.
